summary.overview: The Family Health Optima Insurance Plan is a comprehensive family floater health policy covering inpatient care, day care treatments, modern treatments, and automatic sum insured restoration. Key strengths include loyalty bonuses, recharge benefits, and wellness program rewards.
best_for: Families seeking comprehensive floater cover with modern treatment inclusions
Budget-conscious buyers looking for wellness-based renewal discounts
Policyholders prioritizing automatic restoration and recharge benefits for multiple claims
watch_outs: Mandatory 20% co-payment for insured persons entering at age 61 and above
Proportionate deductions applied on associated medical expenses if room category limits are exceeded
Strict claim submission timeline of 15 days from discharge for reimbursement claims
Cataract treatments are subject to strict per-eye sub-limits
Long waiting periods of 36 months for pre-existing diseases and 24 months for specific listed procedures
next_actions: Review the room rent limits corresponding to your chosen sum insured to avoid proportionate deductions
Register on the Star Health Mobile App to track wellness points and secure renewal discounts
Note down emergency and planned hospitalization intimation timelines (24 and 48 hours respectively)
Ensure all pre-existing diseases are fully and accurately disclosed at the time of proposal

risks.title: 20% co-payment: Age 61 and above
risks.explanation: A 20% co-payment applies when this condition is met (20% of each and every claim amount for fresh as well as renewal policies for Insured Persons whose age at the time of entry is 61 years and above).
risks.quote: This policy is subject to co-payment of 20% of each and every claim amount for fresh as well as renewal policies for Insured Persons whose age at the time of entry is 61 years and above.

risks.title: Room-rent limit with proportionate deduction
risks.explanation: Room rent is capped (Up to Rs. 2,000 per day for 1 lakh sum insured, up to Rs. 5,000 per day for 2 lakh and 3 lakh sum insured, Single Standard A/C Room for 4 lakh sum insured and above). Choosing a costlier room can reduce the payout for the whole bill (doctor fees, tests) in the same proportion.

risks.title: Pre-existing diseases covered only after 3 years
risks.explanation: Any illness you had before buying the policy is not covered until this period of continuous cover is complete.
risks.quote: Expenses related to the treatment of a Pre-Existing Disease (PED) and its direct complications shall be excluded until the expiry of 36 months of continuous coverage

risks.title: Strict Reimbursement Submission Deadline
risks.explanation: Reimbursement claims must be filed within just 15 days of hospital discharge, risking rejection if delayed.
risks.quote: Claim must be filed within 15 days from the date of dis- charge from the Hospital

risks.title: 10% co-payment: Voluntary Co-payment
risks.explanation: A 10% co-payment applies when this condition is met (Optional voluntary co-payment of 10% or 20% carrying corresponding premium discount).
risks.quote: If the Insured Person chooses voluntary co-payment, the Company will provide a discount on premium as per the table given below; Co-payment % | Discount % 10% | 10% 20% | 20%

risks.title: 2 years wait for listed diseases/procedures
risks.explanation: Treatments on the specific list (e.g. Cataract, Benign diseases of the breast, Joint Replacement, Prolapse of Intervertebral Disc) are not covered in this period.
risks.quote: Expenses related to the treatment of the following listed Conditions, surgeries/ treatments shall be excluded until the expiry of 24 months of continuous coverage

risks.title: Sub-limit: Road Ambulance
risks.explanation: This expense is capped at Road ambulance up to Rs. 750 per hospitalization and up to Rs. 1,500 per Policy Period even if your sum insured is higher.
risks.quote: road ambulance expenses up to Rs.750/- per hospitalization and up to Rs.1,500/- per Policy Period shall be payable

risks.title: Sub-limit: Organ Donor Expenses

risks.title: Emergency admission must be reported within 24 hours
risks.explanation: Late intimation can delay or complicate the claim.
risks.quote: Within 24 hours of date and time of Hospitalization if the Insured Person has been hospitalized in an Emergency.

risks.explanation: Restored sum insured cannot be used for the same illness or relapse within the same policy year.
risks.quote: It is made clear that such restored Sum Insured can be utilized only for illness / disease unrelated to the illness / diseases for which claim/s was / were made.
